name: hud_ui_message_release_images
description: HudUiMessage::ReleaseImages releases and clears all weapon-message variant and side-image swap pointers.
known_limits: Tier C first; use the existing VC5SP3 COFF byte target for tier S acceptance when it passes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x413ff0 validate zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault calls for variantImages[0..4] and sideImageSwaps[0..1], followed by nulling sideImageSwaps[1], sideImageSwaps[0], and variantImages[4..0].
The direct release helper 0x46d5a0 zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault is functionally equivalent and tier S.

The native message release-images smoke exercises SelectVariantDisplay, ApplySideImageSwap, and ClearDisplay through typed HudUiMessage fields, then calls HudUiMessage::ReleaseImages and verifies all seven owned image pointer fields are cleared while activeSideImages[0] is preserved.
